Financial infrastructure to grow internet revenue

Companies of every size use our programmable clearing engine to accept card and bank payments online, settle funds across forty currencies, reconcile ledger entries automatically, and manage multi-country tax obligations through a single versioned HTTP API. Deterministic idempotency keys prevent duplicate charges during network retries while webhooks stream settlement events directly into your accounting database.

Direct bank rails and global card acquiring

Direct integrations with major card networks in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific reduce intermediary hops and expose raw issuer decline codes. Adaptive routing evaluates historical authorization rates per BIN range, currency pair, and retry window so recurring subscriptions recover failed renewals without manual intervention from engineering teams.

Double-entry settlement ledger

Every charge, refund, dispute hold, and payout transfer writes an immutable journal entry with millisecond timestamps. Finance teams export daily balance snapshots in CSV or Parquet format and verify penny-exact reconciliation against bank statements.

Typed SDKs and local webhook replay

Official libraries for Go, Ruby, Python, Java, Node, and .NET are generated directly from our OpenAPI specification. Test webhook signatures locally with the command-line listener and inspect request diffs across pinned API dates before upgrading production traffic.
